name: Punchy Fun
tagline: A raw talking-head clip cut punchy and fun: bold subtitles, stickers, sound on every beat.

motion.direction: Punchy and fun: boxed word-by-word subtitles with the spoken word lit yellow, punch-in zooms on every joke or key point, stickers (chips) and stamps for reactions, a counter for any number, short poster slams on the hook and the payoff, a sound on every visual beat. Something new every 1.5–2 s.
